title: keep convergio-api action schema and convergio-mcp help in sync
task_body: The MCP help payload was lagging the api-crate schema; agents got stale action descriptions. Add a coverage test in convergio-api that walks the schema and asserts each action is documented in convergio-mcp::help. Update the help table to match.
rationale: The api-side test is the new check; mcp::help carries the help text it now must match.
